name: Koraki Mavrosa
source:
The MOTH may know something about her, but they've given Ecout almost none of that information. She is often sighted alongside the instigator of the most recent street riots.

Once a timid and well-spoken young lady, she dons an uncouth personality when push comes to shove. However, that façade may be more fragile than she would wish for in the face of danger.
